About Norrsken Foundation

Norrsken is a global ecosystem of founders, funders, thinkers and doers, dedicated to enabling scalable solutions to the world’s greatest challenges. Our work stems from a belief in entrepreneurship and new technology as forces that can positively impact the world.

We run-award winning Norrsken House hubs in Stockholm, Sweden, Barcelona, Spain, Brussels, Belgium and Kigali, Rwanda. We’ve invested in 190+ founders building scalable solutions for planetary progress. Norrsken’s five funds have raised close to $1bn to back exceptional entrepreneurs who combine profit with positive global impact: Norrsken VC, Norrsken22, Norrsken Evolve, Norrsken Launcher and Norrsken Africa Seed Fund.

Norrsken is a non-profit, non-partisan and non-religious foundation. It was founded by Niklas Adalberth, co-founder of payment services unicorn Klarna.
